parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

sub_parameters.name: ClusterIds
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the source instance or cluster. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

sub_parameters.name: JobId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the synchronization job.

sub_parameters.name: OperateType
sub_parameters.description:
The operation type.

Valid values:

*   Create
*   Modify

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The source database type.

Valid values:

*   rds: ApsaraDB RDS.
*   sls: Simple Log Service.
*   polardb: PolarDB.
